name: local-engineering-team
description: A local, voice-ready command center for an AI software engineering team.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @engineering-team/server" "npm run dev -w @engineering-team/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @engineering-team/contracts && npm run build -w @engineering-team/database && npm run build -w @engineering-team/server && npm run build -w @engineering-team/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @engineering-team/database && npm run test -w @engineering-team/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @engineering-team/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @engineering-team/database && npm run typecheck -w @engineering-team/server && npm run typecheck -w @engineering-team/web
